name: Camping 101: First Aid

angles.text: As a Horde traveler, you can learn this training in Razor Hill, Durotar, to help sustain yourself across Kalimdor's rugged frontiers.
As someone who knows Cooking, you know campcraft needs fire. Rawrk says a proper camp requires a fire, a skill taught by cooking trainers.

faq.answer: Rawrk teaches survival campcraft in Razor Hill, Durotar. He shows capable travelers how to make First Aid Kits for the wilderness.
faq.q: Who is Rawrk and where is he found?

aliases: what do i need to camp
faq.answer: Choose an open place in the wild and build a proper campfire. Rawrk warns against camping within town limits and advises you to learn firemaking from a cooking instructor first.
faq.q: What is required before setting up a wilderness camp?

aliases: can i camp in razor hill
where can i place my camp
faq.answer: No. Residents object to tents in the middle of settlements, so find an open place in the wild for your camp.
faq.q: Can camps be pitched inside towns or settlements?

faq.answer: The training teaches you to make a personal First Aid Kit for tending wounds on wilderness journeys.
faq.q: What does this training teach adventurers to craft?

aliases: why do i need cooking for camping
faq.answer: A proper camp needs a fire. Cooking instructors teach basic firemaking, so Rawrk recommends learning from one before you set out.
faq.q: Why does Rawrk recommend learning cooking?

aliases: skill needed for camping first aid
faq.answer: You need to show basic proficiency in medical and survival skills before Rawrk teaches you to make a field First Aid Kit.
faq.q: What prerequisites are needed before learning this craft?

sections.body: Rawrk in Razor Hill teaches capable travelers to make a First Aid Kit. With one, you can tend wounds far from an apothecary or infirmary, where help may be hard to find.
sections.title: Survival on the Frontier

sections.body: Rawrk warns you against pitching a tent in the middle of Razor Hill or another settlement. Find an open place in the wild instead. A camp also needs a fire to see you through the night. Learn basic firemaking from a cooking instructor before you set out.
sections.title: The Art of the Campfire

summary: At Rawrk's camp in Razor Hill, capable travelers learn to make a First Aid Kit for the wilderness. The lesson covers where to camp and why a fire matters.
